notes.title: Patch 1.3; Wave Defense, Skirmishes and New Units!
notes.content:
[p]Just as promised, we come to you with our new update which contains [b]4 wave defense maps[/b], [b]3 skirmishes[/b] and [b]8 new units[/b] to use in both new modes. All of this entirely free for current owners of Cataclysm Wars! Alongside it we also plan to have a demo out for anyone not having the game looking to try it out. [/p][p]
This has been an amazing process for our team and we wanted to thank everyone for all the support we've received on our very first game. We will of course keep supporting the game in case feedback or bug reports come in, but CW is now considered entirely complete, and we will focus on future projects we may soon reveal more on.

In the meantime, enjoy the update, this changelog of all we've added, as well as the many [i][b]many [/b][/i]memes the team has made while developing the game. [/p][list][*][p][b]Added Wave Defense mode, alongside 4 maps on which to fight against overwhelming odds.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added 3 Skirmish missions showcasing other sides of the conflict, one playing as the fearsome Imperial Guard, another confronting a strange new enemy, and the last showing more of Cataclysm Wars' tabletop game roots by adapting a module from it into the game![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added 8 new units present in both Wave Defense and Skirmish, amongst them the fearsome Steam Golem, Royal Sharpshooter Teams and Rocket Launchers.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Game size noticeably reduced yet again.[/p][/*][*][p]Further optimization done on most parts of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an indicator for Guard Mode showing when units are on the defensive.[/p][/*][*][p]Map now has a gradient between the paper-style "fog of war" map and the discovered standard map.[/p][/*][*][p]Barks now scale with the current camera zoom level.[/p][/*][*][p]Unit upgrades are now saved on a per-level basis.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy units attacking your forces are revealed from the fog of war.[/p][/*][*][p]An option has been added for the camera to follow enemy units during their turn if desired.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/8b9751fedf1448073d4225a34ff364d226c917da.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/7f8edfd6ae3d1bd4007db639d2818c7361f56eb5.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/b51027db69a670a1014ca6fff57ad6948d68c91e.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Future Content; New Missions, Units and Wave Defense!
notes.content:
Cataclysm Wars' released was marked by great enthusiasm by its players, more than we expected! What came up often is simply the wish for more, that people enjoyed the game but wanted more content of all type.

Well we are glad to announce that we already have that on the way for everyone, for free!

The first and biggest news is the introduction of... 

[h3]Wave Defense[/h3]
A new game mode where you must buy and manage units as you have to defend your position against overwhelming odds. Survive in four different maps, as both the Imperials and Syrinx.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/4fab0066d6de65f99703d0d746b3e193954086d6.gif[/img]
Pictured here, an Imperial basecamp where you will have to acquire your units for the battle ahead.

[h3]Scenarios[/h3]
Alongside it, we are adding self-contained story missions that shows other parts of the war and Cataclysm Wars' world. We are planning two of them for now, but may add more in due time. 

The first of those is one where you play as the Imperial Guard, the most elite of human formations going on the offensive against the owls. Take control of new heavy units and smash the Royal lines apart!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/a3f5180d7d9cf351b45773310d44090ab9717cc5.png[/img]

[h3]Additional Units[/h3]
And that's still not all! We're adding more units to both side of the conflicts that you will get to use in the story scenarios as well as defense mode. Auxiliary Sappers, Sniper Teams, Handgunners and more will make their debut... alongside more sinister threats that may appear on the field...

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/48393efa648361005806686e5e985617ab9e7b47.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/264e3cef9043b34bb849536abcaee660b31986be.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/699b0c14918c2138e2e12bcb9daba6338a157f5d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/f1da243fa5522d1accbb91a110dd7f648dfdb697.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/8502e90f14043c55015371065121cc7e55fa8791.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/fc05435af6a4c70b7033d5ffdb89ac4a4098f329.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/9d4faddd7386787d59dd38171abc0c7ad47277ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/cb01d753d976c6cfdb532e7b7a1d995d865000f1.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/d330bcee38be86e6d4dcc640ad1f1bf873da1346.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/fc0d971d889df63d7756f1e7b55b65b8bb971aed.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/612b7a6216d5fbb6ed64b245ff9281631aa63e5a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/90e91892ec86048d7e9e76f87a37cc3f01a7a1ea.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Help Improve Cataclysm Wars![/h3]
Cataclysm Wars is our very first title as Chicken Cabal Games, and we still have quite a bit to learn, which is why we're paying particular attention to what players have to say. In this aspect, we're very interested to hear about people that have not yet bought the game but have wishlisted it, so that we know what their expectations are.

If you are one of those people, let us know in this survey what else you would like to see from the game and we will do our best to make it happen!
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd0seK_KuuFHlonFzU0t94-6Qi47cRX0t7yzOyVJy1Sxgg0ig/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=113252911154802675781]Survey Link[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.2; The Syrinx Campaign is Complete!
notes.content:
Withing schedule, the Syrinx Campaign is now entirely complete! You can now complete the Commissar's operation against the Vastragian Empire, and alongside it we've added additional features and fixes!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/47f0fb387f1043518472ceeb296d3e2ad1c19a96.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/47f0fb387f1043518472ceeb296d3e2ad1c19a96.gif[/img][/url]
[b]Features and Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*]Syrinx Campaign complete, mission 4 & 5 added.
[*]Syrinx Mission 1, 2 and 3 have received further polish.
[*]Explosions and War Horns added throughout relevant parts of the game.
[*]Added Defensive Towers and Handgunners, new enemy units appearing through the Syrinx campaign.
[*]Added the ability to command units to move or attack while other units still execute their actions.
[*]Improved unit tokens to display damage the unit has taken at a glance.
[*]Significantly reduced the game's size.
[*]Tutorial's clarity improved.
[*]Can now also use Spacebar to advance dialogue.
[*]UI clarity improved.
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/5458301ff0bf5859ab5530752b8ca89b83869479.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/5458301ff0bf5859ab5530752b8ca89b83869479.gif[/img][/url]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Syrinx T2 Heavy Infantry now display the correct sprite.
[*]Now correctly returns to mission select menu instead of main menu after finishing a level.
[*]Imperial Mission 2 sometimes was not properly marked as a Decisive Victory when applicable, this has been fixed.
[*]Fixed improperly placed attack animation on some units.
[*]Clicking dialogue boxes now no longer deselect units.
[*]Fixed Syrinx units sometimes not upgrading properly.
[*]Fixed rare crash caused by restarting missions.
[/list]
We are also, as stated previously, working on additional content. This is now taking the form of an additional game mode, as well as some one-off missions that will further flesh out the world of Cataclysm Wars.

Look out for more news in the weeks to come!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/c2c4ffeaf4c30bd449993aa233ef83c3135fbd79.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379199/c2c4ffeaf4c30bd449993aa233ef83c3135fbd79.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
We've kept close tab on bug reports both internal and external, and we already have Patch 1.1 here to address some of them. 

[list]
[*]Unit movement failure has been fixed, units will now move as directed on the first go.
[*]Campaign selection graphical revamped.
[*]Mission preview borders added.
[*]Syrinx unit tokens fixed.
[*]Syrinx unit now properly display in the encyclopedia.
[*]Fixed bugged spawn action of syrinx unit on some missions.
[*]Improved loading screen clarity
[/list]

We have also been looking into possible additional content for Catalcysm Wars. Though we cannot say anything yet we will disclose more soon!

notes.title: Cataclysm Wars Out Now!
notes.content:
Cataclysm Wars is now available for everyone to enjoy! It has been quite the development cycle, but we cannot wait to hear your thoughts and opinion on the game, hoping that you enjoy our first title.

We do however have to share a slight damper on things that we hope to have fixed soon. Indeed the recent failure of the power grid in Spain and Portugal has deeply affected one of our developers, leading to setbacks on some parts of the game. As such we are profoundly sorry to inform you all that the last two missions of the Syrinx campaign will not be available on release.

We are also aware of a bug that might sometimes happen where unit will not execute a movement order on the first try. Simply trying again or reselecting them should fix this. Some part of the UI might also look strange at specific resolutions.

We will do our very best to bring the missions to all within the first week of release, as well as to address any bug or feedback that you may have about the game.

We've integrated a bug and feedback report form inside the main menu to make this process easier for all, and will keep close tabs on players' opinions. We thank you all in advance for your interest in Cataclysm Wars, and again hope you will have fun with it!
